name: The Eclipse Mage
source:
One night. One stolen secret. A world on the edge of unraveling.

It was the night when reckless children broke an unspoken law, stealing from the shadows of a forgotten castle.

The night idealism dared to defy a world ruled by fear. And with it, a single spark was lit, one that could reshape the world.

Will it lead to salvation or destruction?

[From [url=https://bart-games.itch.io/the-eclipse-mage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个夜晚。一桩被盗的秘密。一个濒临分崩离析的世界。

在那个夜晚，不知天高地厚的孩子们打破了不成文的禁忌，从一座被遗忘古堡的阴影中盗走了某样东西。

在那个夜晚，理想主义斗胆向恐惧统治的世界发起了反抗。也正因如此，一星足以重塑世界的火种就此点燃。

它最终将引向救赎，还是招致毁灭？

[摘自[url=https://bart-games.itch.io/the-eclipse-mage]itch.io[/url]]
